question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: Steal a march on
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Gain advantage by acting earlier. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Steal a march on"** means to gain an advantage over someone by acting before them or earlier than expected. (किसी पर बढ़त लेना या पहले से कार्य कर लाभ उठाना) • **Example:** By submitting her project a week early, she managed to steal a march on her classmates. • Here, the correct meaning of **"Steal a march on"** is to gain an advantage by acting earlier than others. (पहले कार्य करके लाभ उठाना) • **Example:** The company stole a march on its competitors by launching the product ahead of schedule. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: Withdraw suddenly** (अचानक पीछे हटना): To retreat or pull back unexpectedly. • **Example:** The army withdrew suddenly to avoid further casualties. • **Option 3: Betray secretly** (गुप्त रूप से धोखा देना): To deceive or act dishonestly in a hidden manner. • **Example:** He betrayed his friend secretly by sharing confidential information with the rivals. • **Option 4: Avoid punishment** (दंड से बचना): To escape consequences or penalties for one's actions. • **Example:** Despite his wrongdoing, he managed to avoid punishment due to lack of evidence. 34:T76f, The correct answer is** option 1.**
